Clinical Pathology Faculty - Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine of Rowan University Glassboro, New Jersey Dec 7 2026
The Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine of Rowan University invites applications for a faculty position in Clinical Pathology. This is a full-time, 12-month academic position at the rank of Instructor, Assistant, Associate or Full Professor. Appointment may be in a tenure or clinical track depending on the qualifications and goals of the successful candidate.   Candidates must possess a DVM or equivalent degree, be eligible for licensure in the State of New Jersey, and be ACVP or ESVCP board-certified or board-eligible in Clinical Pathology. The successful candidate will be a founding faculty member of the SSVM and play an integral role in the development and delivery of an integrated veterinary curriculum constructed around organ systems. Clinical service duties include diagnostic service conducted at the SSVM teaching hospital.  This 50,000 square foot state-of-the-art facility located on the Glassboro Campus provides both primary and specialized care for companion, food and fiber animals throughout New Jersey and surrounding states.  Creative scholarly activity is expected to advance the discipline of clinical pathology though the creation and dissemination of new knowledge, but the extent will depend on the candidate’s appointment and may include collaborative or independent research. Salary is commensurate with the applicant’s experience and qualifications. Rowan University offers a generous benefit package which can be viewed at https://sites.rowan.edu/hr/benefits/.
